voiceover: At the center of the Christian faith stands one man — Jesus of Nazareth. This section takes the honest questions about him one at a time. Here is what you will find inside. It starts with the most basic question of all — did he even exist? Then the central question — did Jesus claim to be God, and how did his earliest followers treat him? You will find how the first Christians read the Hebrew Scriptures — whether they really point toward him — and whether his story is unlike the ancient dying-and-rising myths. And the question everything turns on — did he rise from the dead? Each of these is taken on honestly, inside. Every one of these arguments gets a fully-cited deep-dive essay. Each claim is sourced, and the strongest objections are stated fairly, then answered. That is our standard — Checked Before Published. And you will not just read. On every essay an AI tutor answers your questions — ask it anything, or highlight a single sentence and ask about that exact line. Mastery mode lets you explain the argument back in your own words and have it graded. Daily practice brings the key points back just as you are about to forget them. There are pocket cards to share, and a Debate Arena to practise against an AI sceptic before the real conversation. Every essay comes in a plain-English version and a full deep dive, with read-aloud audio. None of this can do your believing for you. What this section makes the case for is that trusting Jesus is not a leap in the dark — it rests on real evidence, honestly weighed. Start anywhere, and follow it where it leads.
